description: This Java class provides utility methods for handling CoAP error responses, including mapping exceptions to CoAP response codes, and responding to CoAP exchanges with appropriate error messages and codes.

classes.name: CoapErrorResponse
classes.description: Utility class for sending error responses over CoAP, including error code mapping and response formulation.

methods.name: isTemporaryError
methods.description: Checks if a Throwable indicates a temporary error that allows client retry.

methods.name: respond
methods.description: Overloaded methods to respond to a CoapExchange with an error cause, message, and response code.

methods.name: toCoapCode
methods.description: Maps a Throwable cause to a corresponding CoAP ResponseCode, with a default fallback.
